hero.title: Welcome to ULearn
hero.subtitle: Transforming Quizzes into Real Learning Experiences
hero.description: ULearn helps teachers create quizzes, assign them to students, correct multiple-choice questions automatically, and track class progress. The first version focuses on a simple and useful quiz workflow for teachers and students.

process.title: How It Works?
process.description: ULearn keeps the workflow simple: create a quiz, share it with students, collect answers, and review performance.

create.title: Create
create.description: Teachers create one quiz with up to 50 questions, including multiple-choice and development questions.

assign.title: Assign
assign.description: Students receive access to the quiz and submit their answers before the teacher closes the evaluation.

review.title: Review
review.description: QCM answers are corrected automatically, while development questions can be reviewed manually by the teacher.

what.question: What is ULearn?
what.answer: ULearn is a quiz platform that helps teachers create academic evaluations and helps students learn through structured practice.

who.question: Who is it for?
who.answer: It is mainly for teachers, tutors, students, and academic groups that need a simple quiz management tool.

quizLimit.question: How many quizzes can a teacher create?
quizLimit.answer: In this first version, one teacher can create one active quiz. If the quiz is deleted, the create button becomes available again.

accountDuration.question: How long does an account last?
accountDuration.answer: For this test version, teacher accounts and related quiz data are kept for three days before being removed.

developmentQuestions.question: Can teachers use development questions?
developmentQuestions.answer: Yes. The quiz can include QCM questions and development questions that the teacher reviews manually.

free.question: Is ULearn free?
free.answer: The first version is free for testing and academic experimentation.
